faq.question: What is Clarify?
faq.answer: Clarify is a professional tool for managing JSON files, translations, and text transformations. It provides advanced features like JSON translation, search & replace, case conversion, and AI-powered file processing.

faq.question: How do I open JSON Translate?
faq.answer: Go to Tools → Open JSON Translate, or use the JSON Translate panel on the main window. You can also access it via the dock system (View → Docks → JSON Translate).

faq.question: What file formats does Clarify support?
faq.answer: Clarify supports JSON, TypeScript (.ts, .tsx), JavaScript (.js, .jsx), and plain text files. It can parse and transform TypeScript export statements automatically.

faq.question: Can I use regex in Search & Replace?
faq.answer: Yes! Enable the 'Regular Expression' checkbox in Search & Replace. Clarify supports full Python regex syntax with capture groups and backreferences.

faq.question: How do I eliminate duplicate JSON keys?
faq.answer: Use JSON Rewriter and enable 'Eliminate Duplicates'. This will merge duplicate keys intelligently, keeping unique values and removing redundant entries.
